title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Week 6 TE Points Leader (PPR)
description:
This market will resolve to the tight end that finishes Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring TE under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 6 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more players are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 6, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring TE in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed player, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past November 4, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 6 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: What will the announcers say during the Seahawks vs Broncos game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official Prime Video announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Seattle Seahawks vs Denver Broncos game on Prime Video, scheduled for October 15, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "Prime Video announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national Prime Video telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf
